text:
Anna C.: Quick pass on the 'Archived versions' empty state. current header is 'No archived versions' which feels blunt. any thoughts on making it friendlier and actionable?
Devon R.: +1. Empty states are a great place to teach. Maybe: 'No archived versions yet' + short line on what archiving does and a CTA.
Hannah (content): How about: 'Nothing archived yet. When you archive a version, it
ppears here so you can reactivate or inspect logs later.' short and explicit.
Samir: Suggest shorter: 'Nothing archived yet. Archive older versions to tidy up routes—you can always reactivate and view metrics.' keeps action and reassurance.
Anna C.: Watch length: guideline for list view empty states is <= 120 chars. The Samir version is 125 chars. Need trim.
Luis M.: What about removing 'older': 'Archive versions to tidy routes. Archived versions can be reactivated and metrics are retained.' That's ~108 chars.
Devon R.: Good. For CTA, instead of generic 'Archive version' we could have a primary CTA 'Archive a version' linking to model versions list, and a secondary 'Learn more' that opens the docs.
Hannah (content): Accessibility nit: ensure the CTA text is meaningful out of context (avoid 'Learn more' alone). Use 'View docs: archiving' or 'See archiving docs'.
Anna C.: Agreed. Final copy proposal to fit 2 lines in the UI: Header: 'No archived versions' Body: 'Archive versions to tidy active routes. Archived versions can be reactivated and metrics are retained.' CTAs: [Archive a version] (primary)  [See archiving docs] (secondary).
Samir: UX behavior: archive CTA should deep-link to model versions filter with '?show=all' maybe. I'll coordinate the URL. Also ensure keyboard focus order goes to the primary CTA.
Luis M.: Also add tooltip microcopy for the small 'i' icon near header: 'Archived versions are removed from routing but kept for audits and metrics.' Limit tooltip to one short sentence.
Anna C.: I'll shorten tooltip to: 'Removed from routing. Metrics & logs kept.' (34 chars). Good for mobile/tooltip constraints.
ui-bot: Reminder: empty state header+body+2 CTAs must render on narrow cards — keep line breaks predictable.
Devon R.: Tiny copy nit: in header maybe keep 'No archived versions' (not 'yet') because we explain in body. shorter header helps scanning.
Anna C.: OK finalizing:
Header: 'No archived versions'
Body: 'Archive versions to tidy active routes. Archived versions can be reactivated and metrics are retained.'
Primary CTA: 'Archive a version' -> models page
Secondary CTA: 'See archiving docs' -> docs link
Tooltip (info icon): 'Removed from routing. Metrics & logs kept.'
Anna C.: I'll add this to the mock and push a PR. tagging @hannah for final tone sign-off. :thumbsup:
